user.title: Walloon hydrometric station
user.description:
Enter the station number to monitor (e.g. L6710 for Givry on the Trouille river).

The full list of {nb_stations} stations is available on hydrometrie.wallonie.be.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach hydrometrie.wallonie.be. Check your Internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_station: Station not found. Check the number on hydrometrie.wallonie.be (click a station on the map: the number appears in the URL).
error.no_series: This station does not publish water level or discharge (inactive or rain-gauge only). Pick an active station on the portal map.
error.api_error: Error returned by the SPW KIWIS service. Try again later.
error.levels_order: Thresholds must be increasing: warn < alert < flood.

init.title: Station options
init.description: Adjust the update interval and the level thresholds (m) used by the alert binary sensors. Thresholds must be increasing.
